subtitle: Lesson 16 · Five lessons, one repeatable method

code:
1. Translate the complaint -> requirements
2. Design -> criteria, steps, locking, actions
3. Document -> purpose, trigger, affects, owner
4. Test -> happy path, boundary, bulk, negative
5. Ship -> only after 1-4 are done
caption: Skipping straight to step 5 is how undocumented automation happens.
